test_skel_state_multiply: test the pymomentum skel_state_np multiply function to compose two skeleton states with broadcasting
test_skel_state_inverse: test the pymomentum skel_state_np inverse function to compute the inverse of a skeleton state
test_skel_state_transform_points: test the pymomentum skel_state_np transform_points function to apply a skeleton state transform to 3D points
test_skel_state_slerp: test the pymomentum skel_state_np slerp function to interpolate between two skeleton states
test_skel_state_to_matrix: test the pymomentum skel_state_np to_matrix function to convert a skeleton state to a 4x4 matrix
